questions.question: New York city was founded by the Dutch in 1624.
questions.question_html: New York city was <u>founded</u> by the Dutch in 1624.
questions.explanation: “founded” gần nghĩa nhất với “established”. Xét nghĩa của từ/cụm từ trong ngữ cảnh câu, không chỉ dịch riêng lẻ.

questions.explanation: “dwellers” gần nghĩa nhất với “residents”. Xét nghĩa của từ/cụm từ trong ngữ cảnh câu, không chỉ dịch riêng lẻ.

questions.explanation: “attractive” gần nghĩa nhất với “appealing”. Xét nghĩa của từ/cụm từ trong ngữ cảnh câu, không chỉ dịch riêng lẻ.

questions.explanation: “rural” mang nghĩa đối lập với “urban” trong câu. Đây là câu hỏi tìm từ trái nghĩa.

questions.passage: It is reported that there is a rising (1) _____ of people living in urban areas. Big cities provide both a significant amount of (2) ______ and higher average salaries. With so many companies and factories, it is easy for city dwellers to find work. Statistics from New York City show that people here have ten times more job opportunities than those (3) _____ the neighboring suburbs and smaller towns. Additionally, greater earnings are also another reason why workers are attracted to large cities. High-skilled workers tend to concentrate in urban centers because they can (4) _____ valuable experiences that are not available in other places. This skilled workforce is, of course, hunted by companies which are often willing (5) _____ higher wages.
